description: Push a project's own URLs to Baidu (data.zz.baidu.com/urls) for expedited crawling. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION that spends the project's real, Baidu-computed daily quota. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_connected' } when the project has no Baidu connection, 'quota_exceeded' (with the last-known remain) when today's quota is already spent, or 'site_not_verified' when Baidu reports the site/token pair as unverified — all as a normal result, never a thrown error, since these are expected operational states.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

urls.description: Absolute URLs to push to Baidu, up to 2000 per call.

name: submit_baidu_urls
